title: Network disruption across multiple colocations in India

timeline.body: Cloudflare is investigating a network disruption across multiple datacenters in India, impacting some Cloudflare services in region. We are working to analyse and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
